TITLE: The Chain Rule Explained
DESCRIPTION: A quick tour of the chain rule, from its statement to a worked example. Aimed at calculus students.
TAGS: calculus, chain-rule, derivatives, math, tutorial

### Segment 1: What Is The Chain Rule
LINES:
- f(g(x))' = f'(g(x)) * g'(x)
- Composition of functions
NARRATION: The chain rule tells us how to differentiate a composition of functions, written f of g of x.

### Segment 2: A Worked Example
LINES:
- d/dx sin(x^2)
- Result: 2x times cos(x^2)
NARRATION: Consider sin of x squared. Applying the chain rule, the derivative is 2x times cos of x squared, not simply 2x \ cos(x^2) as a naive read might suggest.
